# Vendored Skills — Attribution

This directory vendors third-party game-development skills. Each subdirectory
is a git submodule-equivalent snapshot (pinned) of an upstream repo. Licenses
and attribution below.

## awesome-gamedev — `gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills`

- Upstream: https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
- License: Apache-2.0
- Snapshot date: 2026-08-16
- Vendored subset (curated for Game Studio Hermes wave 1):
  - Godot engine (10): godot-gdscript, godot-nodes-scenes, godot-signals-groups,
    godot-2d-movement, godot-tilemap, godot-physics, godot-ui-control,
    godot-animation, godot-audio, godot-export
  - Disciplines (11): create-game-assets, procedural-gen, game-feel, level-design,
    game-ui-ux, input-systems, save-systems, audio-design, performance-optimization,
    physics-tuning
  - Genres (2): puzzle, platformer
  - Workflows (3): prototype-fast, itch-publish, game-jam

## game-studios — `Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios`

- Upstream: https://github.com/Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
- License: MIT
- Snapshot date: 2026-08-16
- Vendored subset (QA + playtest workflows, adapted to kanban flow):
  qa-plan, smoke-check, soak-test, regression-suite, playtest-report,
  test-evidence-review, test-helpers

Full upstream licenses are preserved in each vendored skill's parent metadata
where present. See upstream repos for complete terms.
